era_setting.place: Dublin, California, USA (Alameda County, San Francisco Bay Area)
era_setting.notes: Contemporary US, 2011 onward, so modern vehicles, phones and computer screens are in period. Out of period is the PLACE: a European park, EU number plates, foreign-language signage or an obviously non-US streetscape are all wrong here, and Dublin means Dublin, CALIFORNIA -- an Irish establishing shot pulled on the word `dublin` is the mistake this field exists to make visible. Declared because EP62 greene shipped a modern ballot and a 2011 Range Rover Evoque on an EU plate through five green gates, purely because nothing machine-readable said what century or continent the film was in.
